data.long_meaning: The name Lucrezia is derived from the Latin word ‘lux’, meaning ‘light’. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the light of faith and the divine illumination. Lucrezia is a name of profound spiritual significance, evoking images of purity, enlightenment, and the triumph of the human spirit. The name Lucrezia carries the meaning “Light, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Lucrezia usually hope their child will grow to embody light, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
